title: Madagascar’s Giant Bats Are Getting Smaller
paragraphs: Some bats in Madagascar are very big. They are called flying foxes. Now scientists say these bats are getting smaller.
The scientists looked at 121 old and new bats in museums. The skulls of newer bats are smaller. The change started about 1980.
People hunt these bats for food. After 1980, many bats were sold in markets. Hunting may be the reason.
